column1: # Planted design problems in the OpenAPI documents: spec, the rule expected to catch it (- for none: only a review would), JSON pointer, what it is

column4: a collection without cursor and limit
an error body of its own
a tag not in the document's tags
parameter name differs from the template
no Idempotency-Key header on a payment POST
a card number in a query string (it ends up in access logs)
two booleans (succeeded, failed) for one status
page and size instead of cursor
PUT to start a shift: not idempotent, so it should be POST
a discount as a bare number: percent or rupees?
a date as a plain string, no format
